question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.country_id = 52790
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
city_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        cs1.cust_city,
        cs1.total_sales as total_sales_2019,
        cs2.total_sales as total_sales_2020,
        (cs2.total_sales - cs1.total_sales) * 1.0 / cs1.total_sales as growth_rate
    FROM city_sales cs1
    JOIN city_sales cs2 ON cs1.cust_city = cs2.cust_city
    WHERE cs1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
    AND cs2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city FROM city_growth WHERE growth_rate >= 0.20
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.country_id = 52790
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_total AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        SUM(product_total_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        total_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as quintile
    FROM product_total
),
top_20_percent_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id FROM product_ranked WHERE quintile = 1
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(product_total_sales) as quarter_total
    FROM product_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_share AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.prod_id,
        ps.calendar_quarter_id,
        ps.product_total_sales,
        qt.quarter_total,
        ps.product_total_sales * 1.0 / qt.quarter_total as share
    FROM product_sales ps
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON ps.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_share_2019 AS (
    SELECT prod_id, share as share_2019
    FROM product_share
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1772
),
product_share_2020 AS (
    SELECT prod_id, share as share_2020
    FROM product_share
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776
),
product_share_change AS (
    SELECT 
        p2019.prod_id,
        p2019.share_2019,
        p2020.share_2020,
        (p2020.share_2020 - p2019.share_2019) * 100 as share_change_pp
    FROM product_share_2019 p2019
    JOIN product_share_2020 p2020 ON p2019.prod_id = p2020.prod_id
)
SELECT 
    psc.prod_id,
    psc.share_change_pp,
    ABS(psc.share_change_pp) as abs_change,
    pt.total_sales,
    p.prod_name
FROM product_share_change psc
JOIN product_total pt ON psc.prod_id = pt.prod_id
JOIN products p ON psc.prod_id = p.prod_id
WHERE pt.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_20_percent_products)
ORDER BY ABS(psc.share_change_pp)
